description: Complete the step: pass act, the BODY_JSON from prepare_net_order UNCHANGED and the signature your wallet produced over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Relays to the same public door any HTTP client uses (POST /labor/net/orders, or its /:id/<act>); this server holds no keys and no funds, and the door checks the signature itself. Free with a valid body-bound signature from the wallet that acts. A step moves no NET and holds none, and a dry run order can never record a payment. Ask net_order_status where the order stands and who acts next, because Vealth sends no email. Cost and signer: free, no gas; signed by the person's own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

act.description: The same act prepare_net_order was given.

bodyJson.description: The exact BODY_JSON string from prepare_net_order, unchanged.
